title: Luscious Lyon Miso Soup
description: A twist on the classic Lyon soup, featuring the umami flavor of miso. This hearty soup is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Lyon shallots and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Luscious mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Miso paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the Vegetable Bouillon and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the soup simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with Salt and Black Pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with Fresh Parsley.
